hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Sum Decomposition
hints.text: The score at index i is max(sum(nums[0..i]), sum(nums[i..n-1])).

hints.title: Total Sum Invariant
hints.text: If total sum is S and running prefix sum is P, the suffix sum is S - P + nums[i].

hints.title: Single Linear Pass
hints.text: Maintain running prefix sum and compute max(P, S - P + nums[i]) at each index i.

hints.title: Single Pass Evaluation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def maximumSumScore(self, nums: list[int]) -> int:
        total = sum(nums)
        pref = 0
        ans = -float("inf")
        for x in nums:
            pref += x
            suff = total - pref + x
            ans = max(ans, pref, suff)
        return ans
```

complexity.notes: Initial sum pass followed by single prefix scan.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-summing prefix and suffix at every index takes O(n^2).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate computes prefix and suffix in O(1) per element.
